I will plant improved wheat seed that I got from the extension program last year because it gives better yield than the local kind on this small piece of land. I will put down some urea and DAP fertilizer, and also spread composted manure I prepared during the dry season, since the soil here is tired from many years of farming. My children and I will do all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves by hand—we cannot afford hired labor or chemicals on just 0.07 hectares. We will depend entirely on the rains, as there is no water source close enough to irrigate.
